instrumentation.cost_scope: post-probe snapshot, event derivation and JSON serialization only; excludes pre-probe, input emission, original observers and engine. External process timing needed for total overhead.
instrumentation.observer_off_scope: recorder OFF is not full gameplay-observer OFF

native_review.screenshot_phase: frame_post_draw; interpolated rendering, indexed by latest preceding post_control observation, never claimed post-solver

ground_measurement.scope: actual central motor force dot body velocity plus actual torque dot angular velocity; work on support excluded

support.scope: No exact common moving support reference; optional measurements remain unknown

rotation.axis_scope: support-relative scalar supplied by snapshot; not inferred roll

support.work_scope: signed F dot actual application point velocity; not whole-system energy

measurement_response.scope: First accepted stop/reversal, not best observed. Stop distance is nonnegative forward COM drift until onset of a .25s continuously slow interval (.1m/s,.2rad/s). Interrupted/unsettled stops and absent reversals stay null. Physics-tick sampling; no hardware latency. Target jerk uses existing target acceleration differences only across the same real anchor; body/contact jerk attribution is not inferred.

metric_reasons.acceleration: includes gravity/contact impulses; collision attribution unavailable
metric_reasons.controllable_swing: signed-work phase match only in declared one-hand DRIVE/COUNTER tape; not human skill

response.missing_events: No accepted stop/reverse event leaves the corresponding scalar null

metric_reasons.work: applied contact forces only; ground and torque excluded

pending.acquisition_load_scope: instant contact before existing force blend
pending.motion_scope: shoulder-frame transport plus finite relative gesture; full world sweep

pending.acquisition_load_scope: instant contact before existing force blend
pending.motion_scope: shoulder-frame transport plus finite relative gesture; full world sweep

motion.energy_scope: body_relative_to_weighted_support; excludes gravity/contact/joint/drag work and support kinetic energy

support.scope: All actual supports are stationary; exact common static world reference, not an arbitrary representative material point

scenarios.scope: unchanged Mastery C r1; B1 feet contribution explicitly measured; source W1.5s then reference phase policy, actual beyond-static catch and retained destination after source release
scenarios.swing_proxy_scope: Actual incremental torque work; requires both DRIVE and COUNTER observed work. Null if either phase is unmeasured/zero; no all-roll penalty.

trace.phase_scope: pre_control before application callbacks; post_control after existing application callbacks and before next integration; neither is falsely labelled post-solver
